newsitem.title: USA: Insite Vision says ISV-611 safe in tests.
newsitem.headline: Insite Vision says ISV-611 safe in tests.

text.p: InSite Vision Inc on Tuesday said a Phase I human clinical study of ISV-611 showed the drug was safe and well-tolerated in dosage levels up to 0.1 percent.
ISV-611 is a DuraSite-based form of an investigational drug, lexipafant, that was developed by British Biotech Plc. InSite has a research collaboration with British Biotech for ISV-611 and ISV-120.
Based on the results and on preclinical evaluations, InSite plans to initiate a Phase II study later this year in patients suffering from allergic conjunctivitis.

"We are pleased to have passed this initial clinical hurdle with ISV-611 and look forward to advancing this promising product candidate into efficacy testing for the treatment of allergic conjunctivitis," Kumar Chandrasekaran, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Lexipafant is an antagonistic drug that has been shown to inhibit platelet activating factor activity in various inflammatory conditions.
British Biotech has filed for approval to market the product in the United Kingdom to treat pancreatitis, and it is conducting Phase III trials in the United States.
